notes: Example only. The driver declares these six bounds operator_required because no text file of the clone states them; a real site must replace every rule with the range of its own Mythen II.

energy_threshold.reason: example: the energy threshold range of this detector at this beamline

exposure_time.reason: example: the exposure time range this detector and sample can tolerate

nb_frames.reason: example: the frame count range this acquisition may request

nb_cycles.reason: example: the cycle count range this acquisition may request

frame_period.reason: example: the frame period range this detector can be configured for

delay_after_trigger.reason: example: the trigger delay range this detector can be configured for
